military.t: 📞 Trump: 'Called by RIGHT PEOPLE in Iran — They Want a Deal'
military.d: Trump told reporters Monday he was 'called today by the right people in Iran' and that 'they want to work on a deal.' This was the single biggest market-moving statement of the day — S&P 500 closed +1%+ Mon, erasing all losses since the Iran war began Feb 28. Vance: 'It's a question best put to the Iranians — ball really is in their court.' No formal confirmation from Tehran. Iran FM Araghchi says Iran approached talks 'in good faith' but US was maximalist.

military.t: 🚨 Iran: MAXIMUM COMBAT ALERT. Blockade is 'PIRACY.'
military.d: Iran's acting defence minister declared armed forces on 'maximum combat alert.' Iranian Defence Gen. Talaei-Nik: 'Iran will not allow any interference or aggression by US or other foreign forces in the Strait of Hormuz. Will respond decisively to any aggressor including Israel and the US.' Iran's armed forces called blockade 'piracy' and said its ports are 'either for everyone or for no one.' Thousands rallied in Tehran against the blockade.

military.t: ⚠️ Trump Threatens to ELIMINATE Iranian 'Fast Attack Ships'
military.d: Trump Truth Social post Monday: 'Warning: If any of these ships come anywhere close to our BLOCKADE, they will be immediately ELIMINATED, using the same system of kill that we use against the drug dealers on boats at Sea.' Earlier also threatened any Iranian ship approaching as 'will be sunk.' Creates extreme risk of naval incident that could end ceasefire.

military.t: 🇫🇷🇬🇧 France + UK Convening 40+ Nation Hormuz Mission
military.d: French President Macron announced a 'peaceful multinational mission aimed at restoring freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.' Conference to be held 'in coming days' with UK. UK PM Starmer: 'We're not supporting the blockade — all efforts focused on getting strait fully open.' UK leading planning for coalition of 40+ nations from NATO and beyond. Mission described as 'strictly defensive' and 'separate from warring parties.' Starmer and Macron summit ongoing.

military.t: 📊 IEA + IMF + World Bank: No Quick Relief Even After Hormuz Reopens
military.d: Joint statement from IEA, IMF and World Bank heads: 'The situation remains very uncertain, and shipping through the Strait of Hormuz is yet to normalize. Even after a resumption of regular shipping flows through the Strait, it will take time for global supplies of key commodities to move back towards pre-conflict levels — and fuel and fertilizer prices may remain high for a prolonged period given the damage to infrastructure.' JPMorgan: 'Reopening the Strait has become the market's most time-sensitive priority.'

military.t: 🇨🇳 China FM Wang Yi: Blockade Not in 'Common Interests'
military.d: Chinese FM Wang Yi met UAE special envoy and Pakistani FM Ishaq Dar Monday. Told Dar that the ceasefire is 'extremely fragile' and the 'urgent task is to prevent resumption of hostilities.' Wang: blockading the Strait of Hormuz 'does not serve the world's common interests.' China stands ready to 'work with all sides to safeguard energy security and supplies.' Russia's Lavrov: ready to help find solutions, says agreements apply to Lebanon too.

military.t: 🇮🇱🇱🇧 Netanyahu Enters Lebanon. 100+ Killed This Weekend. Washington Talks
military.d: Israeli PM Netanyahu crossed into Lebanon Sunday. Israeli airstrikes hit border villages, Israel says creating buffer zone. Lebanese authorities: 100+ killed over the weekend from Israeli attacks. Israeli-Lebanese officials meeting in Washington for US-mediated ceasefire talks. Lebanese Red Cross: 57 medics killed in 6 weeks. Israel denies targeting medics, accuses Hezbollah of using ambulances. Macron: Lebanon must be included in ceasefire deal.

assessment.body:
Day 46 — Indian markets closed today for Ambedkar Jayanti. Reopen Wednesday Apr 15.

THE DIPLOMATIC WILDCARD
• Trump: 'I was called today by the right people in Iran. They want to work on a deal.'
• This single statement sent S&P 500 to close +1%+ Mon — erasing ALL losses since the Iran war began Feb 28
• Vance: 'ball is in Iran's court.' No formal confirmation from Tehran.
• Iran FM Araghchi says Iran approached talks 'in good faith' but US was maximalist
• Key: Ceasefire officially expires Apr 22 — 8 days. This is the next critical binary event.

BLOCKADE DAY 2 — HARDENING
• Iran declares maximum combat alert. Armed forces: 'will not allow any interference by US or foreign forces.'
• Iran calls blockade 'piracy.' Thousands rally in Tehran.
• Trump threatens to 'ELIMINATE' Iranian fast attack ships. Creates extreme risk of naval incident.
• 34,000+ ships have diverted from Hormuz in past month (Al Jazeera). Insurance 10x pre-war rates.
• 17 vessels crossed Saturday (Windward) — <10% of pre-war levels.

COALITION SPLIT
• France + UK convening 40+ nation 'peaceful multinational mission' to restore freedom of navigation.
• Strictly defensive, separate from warring parties. Conference in 'coming days.'
• Macron: Lebanon must be included in ceasefire deal.
• China: blockade 'does not serve common interests.' Russia: supports ceasefire applying to Lebanon.
• UK NOT joining US blockade — Starmer: 'All efforts focused on getting strait fully open.'

INDIA MARKET SNAPSHOT (Apr 13 CLOSE / Today Holiday)
• Sensex: 76,847 (-702 / -0.91%). Recovered from 75,868 intraday low.
• Nifty: 23,842 (-207 / -0.86%). Recovered from 23,556 intraday low.
• FII net sold ₹1,244 Cr Apr 13. DII net bought ₹2,051 Cr.
• Brent $99.36 Mon close. Rupee 93.33/USD.
• VIX eased from 22+ spike as Trump 'right people' comment revived hope.
• Markets reopen Wed Apr 15 — watch Trump-Iran contact developments overnight.

IEA + IMF + WORLD BANK WARNING
• Joint statement: 'Even after a resumption of regular shipping flows, it will take time for global supplies to move back towards pre-conflict levels — fuel and fertilizer prices may remain high for a prolonged period given the damage to infrastructure.'
• JPMorgan: 'Reopening the Strait has become the market's most time-sensitive priority.'
• US Energy Secretary Wright: prices will peak 'in coming weeks' if traffic meaningfully resumes.

KEY DATE: APR 22 — CEASEFIRE EXPIRY
• 8 days remain on the 2-week ceasefire.
• If no deal by Apr 22: ceasefire lapses — IRGC maximum combat alert + Trump 'locked and loaded' = extreme escalation risk.
• If deal before Apr 22: Sensex could surge 5-10%, Brent collapse toward $75-80.
• Trump's 'right people called me' comment is the first positive signal since Islamabad collapse.

VERDICT: Cautiously volatile. The market is pricing in a 'deal possible' scenario but hedging with blockade risk. Apr 22 is the event horizon. Watch for any formal Iran response to Trump's 'right people' claim. India exposure remains 85%+ Hormuz crude dependency with 6-8 weeks buffer — every day of blockade shortens that window.
